record.what_it_does: AI image and video generation platform with a REST API, CLI and hosted MCP.
record.auth_notes: The REST API (api.higgsfield.ai) uses the header `Authorization: Key ${HF_API_KEY_ID}:${HF_API_KEY_SECRET}`, with credentials generated in the console at open.higgsfield.ai. The key is shown only once. The hosted MCP (mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp) uses standard OAuth 2.0: its protected-resource metadata points to a Clerk authorization server at higgsfield.ai/_clerk, with the authorization-code flow plus PKCE (S256) and scopes openid, email and offline_access. Dynamic client registration is available at higgsfield.ai/_clerk/oauth/register. That OAuth path covers the MCP only; the REST API still needs a per-user key ID and secret. The CLI uses browser sign-in (`higgsfield auth login`).
record.access_notes: Anyone can sign up and create API credentials in the console, and no plan or subscription is required. However, the API runs only on a prepaid USD balance: you register a payment method and top up at least $5. That balance is separate from consumer plan credits. I found no free API credits, so real testing costs at least $5. The MCP and CLI draw on the user's own Higgsfield plan credits.
record.api_breadth_notes: The API is generation-focused. Each model has its own submit endpoint (many image and video models), plus request status (/requests/{id}/status) and cancel (/requests/{id}/cancel). There is no account, asset or other resource CRUD. Python and TypeScript SDKs wrap the REST API.
record.mcp_notes: Official hosted MCP at https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp. It uses OAuth 2.0 through Clerk (higgsfield.ai/_clerk) with PKCE and dynamic client registration, and no API key is needed. The official CLI is @higgsfield/cli (`npm i -g @higgsfield/cli`), which works with MCP-compatible CLI agents. A community wrapper also exists (geopopos/higgsfield_ai_mcp).
record.blocker_notes: This is not a hard blocker. The REST API has no per-user OAuth, so each user supplies their own key ID and secret, and usage needs a prepaid balance (minimum $5). The official hosted MCP already offers OAuth with dynamic client registration, which overlaps with a Composio toolkit.
